content:
elaine (security): Heads-up: launching Audit Export Tool v1 (preview) for Private/VPC customers. Purpose: provide a downloadable, signed bundle of telemetry and audit logs that customers can ship to auditors without exposing live telemetry endpoints. Docs: https://internal.redwood/docs/audit-export-v1. Please review if you touch compliance/customer requests.

drew (eng): Nice. What's the telemetry retention window included in the bundle by default? Any PII scrubbing?

elaine (security): Default bundle includes 90 days of logs with PII redaction applied per our standard scrubbing config. Customers can request a longer window (up to 3 years) via signed attestation workflow — see doc.

karim (product): Good to note: this is opt-in for customers. For Private/onprem we provide a local exporter CLI that packages and signs with customer KMS/HSM. For VPC customers we offer a managed export option to a customer bucket tied to their key.

release-bot: Release pipeline queued: audit-export-v1 -> staging (CI #4899). ETA 6h. :package:

sam (legal): Heads-up from legal: the export bundle includes a cover letter template for auditors and a minimal export agreement that customers must accept before we create extended retention bundles. We added language for cross-border transfer risk in appendix C.

marco (sales): Will this change the standard onboarding checklist for new Private customers? Some prospects asked for a turnkey audit package.

elaine (security): Action: add checkbox to onboarding: "Audit Export Tool preview enablement". Karim, can Product add a short one-pager for AEs that explains limitations (preview, manual attestation for extended retention)?

karim (product): On it. I'll draft AE one-pager and include sample CLI steps. Quick CLI snippet for the local exporter:

```bash
redwood-audit export --start 2025-01-01 --end 2025-03-31 --format signed-tar --kms-key /var/run/hsm/key.pem --output /tmp/acme-audit-2025Q1.tar.gz
```

marco (sales): Perfect. Also request: include an FAQ bullet about what we *don't* include (raw model weights, encrypted KV cache, and ephemeral request bodies masked).

elaine (security): Will add. Final action items: @drew validate offline signing flow for air-gapped customers; @sam confirm legal appendix language; @karim produce AE one-pager + customer-facing FAQ; @release-bot run staging and post results. Tracker: https://internal.redwood/tracker/AUDIT-7. Close unless blockers. :lock:
